name: Chibi Chibi Fiancee
source:
Shijo Fumito, the hero of this story, is a kind hearted, weak minded teacher at a private school.
One day, two of his pupils, both girls, unexpectedly show up at his door. They tell him they are his fiancees, and that they will be living with him from now on!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE035417.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
故事的主人公四条文人是一位心地善良、意志薄弱的私立学校老师。
有一天，他的两个学生，都是女孩，意外地出现在他家门口。他们告诉他，他们是他的未婚妻，从现在起他们将和他住在一起！

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE035417.html]英文DLSite[/url]]
